en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a European city with a river or canal winding through the center, lined by trees and mid‑rise apartment blocks. In the foreground there are partially constructed residential buildings and open fields; further back lies a denser historic core with church spires and compact housing. In the distance, large bodies of water and low, forested land are visible, suggesting a coastal or lakeside city. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.
